name: B10-0590/2025 (ECR) – Mass kidnapping of children in Nigeria, including from St Mary’s Catholic School in Papiri
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the mass kidnapping of children in Nigeria, including from St Mary’s Catholic School in Papiri
part_text:
The European Parliament strongly condemns the mass kidnapping of more than 300 schoolchildren and 12 teachers from St Mary's Catholic School in Papiri, Nigeria, on 21 November 2025. It calls for the immediate and unconditional release of everyone still held. It urges Nigeria to rescue the remaining hostages, protect schools, bring the perpetrators to justice and do more to stop violence against Christian communities. It also asks the European Union and its member states to support Nigeria with aid and help against criminal and terrorist networks. This is an opinion; it does not change any law.

- **What changes:** Nothing yet. The Parliament asks Nigeria to act and the European Union to give support.
- **Who it affects:** The kidnapped children and teachers, their families, and Christian communities in Nigeria.
- **What happens next:** The resolution is sent to Nigeria's government and parliament; no further steps are set out.
